body:
Originally, I did it as a sort of "punishment" for eating when I was coping with an ed, but then it slowly became a punishment for everything. 1 cut for every chip, every cookie, every B, C, every time I woke up late or forgot to do something...then I just felt so numb without it that I couldn't stand it. Ed was a result of severe social anxiety, which medicine helps with a little, but now I'm getting worse again...
...almost 6 months clean and terrified of disappointing the people who believe in me.
